High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench

Court No. - 11
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 349 of 2024
Applicant :- Harish Kumar Srivastava
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Mewa Ram Satyarthi Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J.
Heard Mewa Ram Satyarthi, learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA.
In view of the proposed order, the notice to opposite party No. 2 is hereby dispensed with.

The applicant has filed this 482 Cr.P.C. petition praying for quashing of the charge-sheet dated 23.4.2023 and cognizance order dated 18.12.2023 in F.I.R. / Case Crime no. 362 of 2022 u/s 419,
420, 406, 354, 506 IPC, (State vs. Harish Kumar Srivastava ), P.S. Kotwali City, District Balrampur pending before the C.J.M, Balrampur.

At the outset, learned counsel for the applicant has prayed that the petitioner is ready to surrender before the learned court below and wants to move an application for bail, therefore, direction may be issued to the learned court below for expeditious disposal of bail application of the petitioner.
Harish Kumar Srivastava vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko. ...

entities.text: Harish Kumar Srivastava vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned Additional Government Advocate for the State has no objection to the aforesaid prayer.

Therefore, without entering into merits of the issue, the instant petition is disposed of, however, it is provided that in case the petitioner surrenders before the learned court below within a period of four weeks from today and moves application for bail relating to the aforesaid criminal case, the same shall be considered and disposed of in the light of dictum of Apex Court in re: Satender Kumar Antil vs. CBI and others in Special Leave to Appeal (Criminal) No. 5191 of 2021 with expedition without adjourning the case for any unnecessary reason.
.
